subject: prd/ecosystem-help
statement: When invoked without a specific problem, the help skill shall present the ecosystem catalog: every skill on the installed surface and every pipeline stage from the shipped map, each with its one-line purpose, when-to-use, and the map's built-status, derived at invocation from the live surfaces.
rationale: J1 — orient without reading the corpus
fit_criterion: every skill present on the installed surface appears exactly once; every stage row of the shipped map appears carrying its status; zero entries lack a resolvable live source
